sn56.45:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn56.45:1.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
sn56.45:1.3: addasā kho āyasmā ānando sambahule licchavikumārake santhāgāre upāsanaṃ karonte dūratova sukhumena tālacchiggalena asanaṃ atipātente poṅkhānupoṅkhaṃ avirādhitaṃ,
sn56.45:1.6: yatra hi nāma dūratova sukhumena tālacchiggalena asanaṃ atipātessanti poṅkhānupoṅkhaṃ avirādhitanti.”
sn56.45:2.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando vesāliṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṃkami. …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn56.45:2.2: “idhāhaṃ bhante, pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
sn56.45:2.3: addasaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante, sambahule licchavikumārake santhāgāre upāsanaṃ karonte. dūratova sukhumena tālacchiggalena asanaṃ atipātente poṅkhānupoṅkhaṃ avirādhitaṃ.
sn56.45:2.5: sikkhitā vatime licchavi kumārakā. susikkhitā vatime licchavikumārakā.
sn56.45:2.6: yatra hi nāma dūrato va sukhumena tālacchiggalena asanaṃ atipātessanti poṅkhānupoṅkhaṃ avirādhitanti”.
sn56.45:3.2: katamaṃ nukho dukkarataraṃ vā durabhisambhavataraṃ vā,
sn56.45:3.3: yo dūratova sukhumena tālacchiggalena asanaṃ atipāteyya poṅkhānupoṅkhaṃ avirādhitaṃ, yo vā satadhā bhinnassa vāḷassa koṭiyā koṭiṃ paṭivijjheyyāti?
sn56.45:3.4: etadeva bhante, dukkarataraṃ ceva durabhisambhavataraṃ ca yo vā satadhā bhinnassa vāḷassa koṭiyā koṭiṃ paṭivijjheyyāti.
sn56.45:3.5: atha kho te ānanda duppaṭivijjhataraṃ paṭivijjhanti ye “idaṃ dukkha”nti yathābhūtaṃ paṭivijjhanti …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti, yathābhūtaṃ paṭivijjhati. tasmātiha
sn56.45:4.1: ānanda, “idaṃ dukkha”nti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
